description: Na₃YCl₆ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent Cl¹⁻ atoms. There are three shorter (2.74 Å) and three longer (2.96 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Cl¹⁻ atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent YCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 40°. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.79 Å. Y³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Cl¹⁻ atoms to form YCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 40°. All Y-Cl bond lengths are 2.64 Å. Cl¹⁻ is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Y³⁺ atom.
